## TRA Timeline

#### De-SPAC and TRA execution

- 2021-12-12: Business Combination Agreement signed between SVF Investment Corp. 3 and Symbotic Holdings LLC; form-of TRA attached as Exhibit E to the BCA
- 2022-05-12: Form-of TRA carried in Annex K to the final S-4/A
- 2022-06-07: De-SPAC closed; SVF 3 renamed Symbotic Inc.; executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.2 to the closing 8-K

## Explanation

Symbotic Inc. executed this TRA on June 7, 2022 at the closing of its de-SPAC Up-C business combination with Symbotic Holdings LLC, agreeing to pay 85% of net cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups generated by future exchanges of New Symbotic Holdings Common Units for Class A common stock. The TRA Parties are the pre-combination Symbotic LLC members, including founder Richard Cohen's affiliated entities and Walmart. No TRA liability has been accrued on any balance sheet from FY2022 through FY2026 Q2 because Symbotic maintains a full valuation allowance against its U.S. deferred tax assets; however, the FY2023 10-K disclosed projected aggregate TRA payments of approximately $412.2M over 41 years from exchanges already made, with the potential to reach approximately $5.2B if all remaining Common Units were exchanged. No amendment, restatement, or termination instrument has been filed; the TRA remains in force. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
